description: This file contains the implementation of an order-preserving hash map and set data structures based on a specialized hash table (sherwood_v3_table). It includes hash policies, internal data structures, and class templates for map and set with custom hash and equality functions, designed for maintaining insertion order and efficient lookups.

classes.name: order_preserving_flat_hash_map
classes.description: A hash map that preserves insertion order, supporting fast lookup, insertion, and deletion, with customizable hash and equality functions.

classes.name: flat_hash_set
classes.description: A hash set implementation based on the same underlying hash table, supporting insertion and lookup while maintaining insertion order.

classes.name: power_of_two_std_hash
classes.description: A hash functor that uses power-of-two hash policy for hashing.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access or insert element by key, returning reference to mapped value.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Access element by key with bounds checking, throws if key not found.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Insert element with perfect forwarding of arguments.

methods.name: insert_or_assign
methods.description: Insert new element or assign to existing element by key.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Find element by key, returns iterator.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Remove element by iterator or key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Remove all elements from the container.

methods.name: rehash
methods.description: Rehash the table to a new bucket count.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserve capacity for at least the specified number of elements.
